original.target_description: Experiment 4: composite current positive emotion during anticipation versus retrospection of hypothetical ski vacation

n.exclusions: No exclusions reported for this test; anticipation n = 45 and retrospection n = 50.

replication.target_description: Hypothetical resort vacation: composite influence on current mood (Mean of DV1), anticipation versus retrospection

n.sample_role: Participants in two mutually exclusive between-subject vacation temporal-perspective conditions, anticipation 288 and retrospection 276.
n.exclusions: Main manuscript analytic sample after general funneling, before the supplementary additional exclusions. Only participants who had taken a vacation proceeded (p. 29). General funneling excluded inability to mentally time travel (2) or write a contemplated/recalled scenario (2), p. 38. Supplementary additional exclusions analyzed separately.
n.location: Main manuscript p. 39, Table 8b, Vacation, Anticipation and Retrospection N columns; p. 41 Table 9b

es.location: Main manuscript p. 41, Table 9b, Vacation, intensity of emotion (DV2)

p.location: Main manuscript p. 41, Table 9b, Vacation, intensity of emotion (DV2)

reported_success.quote: we found support in menstruation (d = 0.46, 95% CI [0.20, 0.73] and vacation (d = 0.18, 95% CI [0.01, 0.35]).

notes:
Extracted by neutral outcome description; supplied replication page locators interchange current emotion (DV1, p. 40) and predicted/remembered emotion (DV2, p. 41). No values converted. Replication main tables report pre-exclusion analyses, apart from general funneling. Supplied neutral descriptions for 1746 and 1747 both identify the current-emotion contrast in Experiment 4; no distinct tests can be established from their wording, so both retain the same matching composite test. Original additionally reports predicted/remembered enjoyment d = 0.14, p = .507 and a covariate-adjusted temporal-perspective contrast d = 0.45, p = .032; neither substituted for the neutral description. Replication changed ski vacation to generic resort vacation (p. 35). Authors narrative support for vacation refers to the mood component (d = 0.18), whereas composite DV1 p = .074; Authors narrative verdict is successful for vacation overall; it is not a specific verdict on the composite DV1 test, and its quoted support refers to a different component.
Completion source review (n_r): Table 8b gives distinct anticipation/retrospection counts for the uniquely located p. 41 vacation DV2 independent-sample test. Main-analysis exclusion scope is documented, with the additional-exclusion analysis retained separately.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Printed Cohen’s d for the unique vacation intensity-of-emotion DV2 comparison at the supplied p. 41 locator; vacation adapted to a general resort scenario as documented on p. 25.
Completion source review (pval_value_r): Exact printed p for the same DV2 vacation comparison as d = -0.01.
